text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho's goal is to find her racing magic and become a grand witch like her grandma.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her sheer talent for running is so overwhelming that seeing her race is akin to seeing magic in motion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she can be a little bratty. She always treats me like her "familiar," and proves herself a handful the moment our first training session begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, my journey as an overworked familiar for a demanding magical girl on a quest to win the Twinkle Series has officially begun!
